description: Census Survey of Construction averages for apartment buildings: months from permit to start and from start to completion, by U.S. region and building size (5-9, 10-19 or 20+ units), for one completion year with the ten-year trend, plus what the build length means for HUD upfront MIP and construction interest.

region.description: Census region; omit for all five rows.

year.description: Year of completion; default is the latest Census year.
